note: The fix gives ParserOptions.ExpressionDepthLimit a default, checked in Parser.EnterExpression as the parser descends. Present from 0.16; earlier releases lack it and read as unknown. Reached wherever the app parses templates; an app that sets ExpressionDepthLimit itself is not affected, and a code scan cannot see that setting.
